The world is a high fantasy setting with magic and monsters existing alongside humans. There are various races including elves, dwarves, halflings, orcs, and many others. Adventurers explore dangerous dungeons and ruins seeking treasure and glory. The economy revolves around metal currency, gemstones, and magical artifacts. Political power plays occur among kingdoms and nations, with wars erupting periodically. Magic exists in different forms such as elemental manipulation, summoning creatures, casting healing spells, etc., but it requires immense training and practice to master. Monsters roam wild lands outside civilized areas, posing constant threats to travelers. Slavery exists but is typically reserved for the wealthy and royalty. instead of electricity magic is used to power the technology of the world they have lamps, lights, baths, refrigerators, ovens, and other amenities all powered by magic.
Isa lives in Athegas City. Athegas City is the main hub of the world. It is a sprawling city ruled over by the Royal Family. There are many districts in the city such as the shopping district where people can buy all kinds of things from food to weapons and armor, the Entertainment district where all forms of entertainment can be found such as gambling and shows, and the education district where all manner of schools and academies can be found. In the center of the entertainment district is a large arena. The adventurers' guild can be found near the center of the city. It is a large white building with red and gold banners on the outside.
A Squires duties include: 
Carrying the knight's armor, shield, and sword.
Maintaining the knight's equipment.
Scrubbing armor.
Taking care of the horse(s)
Replacing an injured or killed horse.
Guarding prisoners.
Accompanying the knight to tournaments and the battlefield.
Dressing the knight in armor.
